headline: Congress named a Prescott, Arizona post office after former senator Barry Goldwater.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 442 Miller Valley Road in Prescott, Arizona, as the "Barry M. Goldwater Post Office." It is a naming change only. It does not change how the post office operates, what services it offers, or its staffing.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 18, 2014.
